Harvest Cafe 📍

Recently got a chance to swing by the @harvestcafesiny to try out their brunch and we did not leave hungry! This cafe is special because their mission statement is to not only serve delicious food but to also train individuals in the kitchen with intellectual and developmental disabilities as they gain experience and learn new skills pertaining to the food service industry.👨🏻‍🍳

Food Ordered: 👇🏼

• BEC Pancake Tacos
• “The Harvest Benny” (Crab Cake Benedict)
• Corned Beef Hash
• Eggs & Bacon
• Buffalo Chicken Fries
• Banana Walnut French Toast

All of the food was valid, the service was great, and the staff were very hospitable during the time we were there. Shoutout to the head chef @chef_joeyp for killing it over there too. We’ll definitely be back! ✅
